periods.description: Sword-shaped activation and control devices paired with Armored Drag-Rides, used to summon machines, connect armor, and direct weapons by mental control.
periods.principles: The user draws the Sword Device, presses the hilt activation, chants or commands the paired machine, and then uses the blade as a control interface after link start.
periods.classification: One Sword Device per standard Drag-Ride; special dual-device cases exist such as Lisha's Chimeric Wyvern.
periods.origin: Excavated with or built to pair with ancient Drag-Ride bodies.
limitations: loss or destruction of the device disables control
requires paired machine and user compatibility
dangerous if drawn without authorization under academy rules
